o.text:
From düşün- + -cə.
Cognate with
Turkish düşünce.
Uzbek tushuncha,
Bashkir төшөнсә (tüşünsä).
From fal + -çı. Cognate with Ottoman Turkish فالجی (falcı).

A partial calque of Russian кида́ла (kidála), with the lexical root кида́ть (kidátʹ, “to throw, to ditch → to swindle”) being calqued and the suffix -щик (-ščik) copied. By surface analysis, atmaq + -şik.

Inherited from Proto-Turkic *yabgan (“unpleasant”).
Cognate with Turkish yavan.
From Proto-Turkic *yidge (“jujube, berry”). Cognate with Kazakh жиде (jıyde), Turkish iğde, Kyrgyz жийде (jiyde), Uzbek jiyda, etc.
